# OBS021 `deprecated-omp-include`

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="enabled by default" />

`include 'omp_lib.h'` instead of the `omp_lib` module.

## Why

`omp_lib.h` is deprecated by the OpenMP specification; the `omp_lib` module provides the same
routines with explicit interfaces.

## Reported

```fortran
include 'omp_lib.h'
```

## Preferred

```fortran
use omp_lib
```

## Suppressing

For one occurrence, with the reason on the same line (or alone on the line before the statement):

```fortran
! fobis: ignore[OBS021] <why this occurrence is fine>
```

For the whole project, `ignore = OBS021` in the fobos [`[lint]` section](/cookbook/analysis#choose-the-rules).

## Equivalent

Fortitude rule `OB211` (see [Lint Rules](/lint-rules/#relation-to-fortitude)).
